exposure: prior successful vaginal birth after caesarean section
macrosomia as past indication of cesarean delivery
outcome: success rate of vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: 416 mothers who gave birth by caesarean section
finding: The success rate of VBAC was low (41%), and factors associated with successful VBAC included macrosomia as a past indication of cesarean delivery, prior VBAC, history of vaginal birth, cervical dilatation at admission, and duration of labor.
